edges.reason: Constructor parameter token_ is stored into _token.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ is stored into _beneficiary.
Day-aligned releaseStartTime_ is stored into _releaseStartTime.
daysOfTimelock_ is multiplied by SECONDS_OF_A_DAY when computing _releaseEndTime.
releaseStartTime_ is added to the timelock duration to set _releaseEndTime.
Constructor parameter totalBenefit_ is stored into _totalBenefit.
Constructor validates _releaseEndTime against block.timestamp, making deployment timestamp dependent.
releasedBalance depends directly on block.timestamp for the vesting computation.
terminate aligns _releaseEndTime using block.timestamp modulo a day.
releasedBalance reads _releaseStartTime.
releasedBalance reads _releaseEndTime.
releasedBalance reads _totalBenefit for prorating.
unreleasedBalance subtracts releasedBalance from the total benefit.
unreleasedBalance reads _totalBenefit.
withdraw reads _withdrawedBalance to compute the pending amount.
withdraw uses releasedBalance() as the upper bound of the payout.
withdraw computes the local amount to transfer.
withdraw updates _withdrawedBalance with the local amount before the transfer.
_beneficiary is the recipient of the external safeTransfer call.
Local amount is passed as the value of the safeTransfer call.
withdraw invokes the external token transfer.
External token call transfers control out of withdraw, allowing reentrant behaviour if the token is malicious.
terminate computes the unreleased amount to forward to the owner.
terminate invokes the external token transfer to the owner.
Local amountToWithdraw is passed as the value of the safeTransfer call.
External token call returns control to terminate after state mutation.
terminate sends the unreleased balance to owner(), tying fund flow to ownership.
onlyOwner compares owner() against the caller (msg.sender) for authorization.
onlyOwner gates terminate so only the owner can drain unreleased funds.
onlyOwner gates transferOwnership.
onlyOwner gates renounceOwnership.
isNotTerminated prevents repeated termination.
isNotTerminated reads the _isTerminated flag.
terminate sets _isTerminated to true.
terminate overwrites _totalBenefit with the released balance.
terminate overwrites _releaseEndTime with the current day start.
terminate uses releasedBalance() to clamp the total benefit.
transferOwnership takes the new owner parameter.
transferOwnership calls _setOwner to persist the new owner.
_setOwner writes the privileged _owner state variable.
newOwner flows into _setOwner's parameter.
owner() reads _owner.
sendValue forwards the recipient to the low-level value call.
sendValue forwards the amount as call value.
Constructor calls _setOwner(_msgSender()) to initialize ownership.
Constructor sets the initial owner from msg.sender.
_setOwner caches the previous owner in a local variable before overwriting.
safeTransfer routes through _callOptionalReturn into Address.functionCall / functionCallWithValue low-level call.
terminate's safeTransfer also routes into the low-level functionCallWithValue.
functionCallWithValue performs the raw call with value, the same low-level primitive as sendValue.
token() returns _token.
beneficiary() returns _beneficiary.
totalBenefit() returns _totalBenefit.
withdrawedBalance() returns _withdrawedBalance.
